name: fde-demo-builder
description: Turn a raw screen recording into a polished, VO-narrated demo video — fully scripted (ffmpeg + edge-tts + headless Chrome), no video editor. v2: word-synced animated b-roll + multi-voice narration. v3: booth-ready production films from real pixels (original screen → zoom, real scrolls and typing), narration as the clock, deterministic render, linear-loudness mastering, QA gates. v4: HyperFrames-inspired production craft — velocity-matched seams with a seam gate, camera kit + motion diagnostics, caption lane + overlays, band-limited voice carve + audio gates, scene lint + determinism canary + golden snapshots + doctor, BRIEF/STORYBOARD review loop, blocks library, media ledger + export presets, honest finishing. Every video carries the mandatory 'Crafted with FDE Demo Builder · by Ahmed Awan' end-screen credit.
